50453.shortDescription: **Research** the *Elite Drone Mothership* capable of launching Drones for coastal hit-and-run tactics.
50453.title: Cutting-Edge Tech III

50454.helpDescription: Elite Drone Mothership is a versatile Naval unit that launches Drones to scout, deal damage to enemy ships and buildings, and drop Sea Mines to protect itself from stronger Naval Units. It is best to build fleets of them for maximum effectiveness, and not take them to Open Seas, as they are slow and vulnerable when not near a coast.
50454.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** is an advanced unit that uses  *drone units* to attack from safety of coastal Waters. We need to mobilize one to fight Mutants from afar!

[image, missions-mission_81]
50454.shortDescription: **Mobilize** the *Elite Drone Mothership* capable of launching drones while being self-sufficient in the field.
50454.title: Cutting-Edge Tech IV

50455.helpDescription: Explosive Drones are effective against surface naval units, buildings, and mutants. Elite Drone Mothership and the Drone Operator are units that can deploy them, and they require Deployable Gear to be used. The Explosive Drone will self-destruct when it reaches a target.
50455.longDescription:
**Elite Drone Mothership** allows us to deploy various drones, and we must use *Explosive Drone* to quell the Mutant threat from afar.


[image, missions-mission_82]

50460.helpDescription:
Howlers are the weakest Mutant unit, effective against soft targets and devastating against population within cities, you should prevent them from reaching any of your cities with everything you have at your disposal. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put ordinary infantry into a hospital or a grave, so prepare accordingly.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani is an unknown figure reaching out to advance his research on how to defeat mutants, or at least that is what he claims. He is not sharing everything he knows about Mutants. He asked us to fight Howlers, a serious rising threat to humanity.
50460.longDescription:
“*Greetings, leaders of the world. I am **Doctor Pasar Sheytani**, an independent researcher battling the evolving mutant plague. Apologies in advance, for this is a one-way transmission.*”
“*I am reaching out to a select few of you who have shown prominence and ambition to be greater than others and to, not only survive but thrive in the world that has fallen to shambles.*
*The recent violent and rapid mutations occurring are a threat to all life, and very much worth investigating. I believe you should directly engage the mutant threat. Please, confront and attempt to defeat the weaker Mutants, vulgarly nicknamed the “Howlers” by the global media. Send me the results once complete, and I will provide you with supplies for your cause.*”

[image, missions-mission_87]
50460.shortDescription: **Destroy** *four Howlers* to suppress the growing mutant threat.
50460.title: Survival of the Fittest I

50461.helpDescription:
Bone Crushers are a strong Mutant unit, effective against soft targets and armored units alike, and still deadly against population within cities, you should prevent them from reaching any of your cities with everything you have at your disposal. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put an ordinary human into a hospital, so prepare accordingly.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani seems to be a dubious figure that speaks, in his one-way transmissions, as if he wants us to fail. Our troops fought bravely, and we will fight back and win against the mutant threat. These new mutants will fall as the last one.
50461.longDescription:
“*It seems that the mutants under-performed against your military strength, surprising. Yes, that is good, thank you for providing the research data. For the next step of the research, it seems the mutants have evolved further. Destroy two Bone Crushers, these larger heavily armed mutations that control machinery. Proceed as we agreed, and you will be handsomely rewarded with my supplies as well as the accolades that will certainly come after we cleanse the world of… this plague.*”

[image, missions-mission_88]
50461.shortDescription: **Destroy** *two Bone Crushers* to prevent the evolving mutants from reaching your cities.
50461.title: Survival of the Fittest II

50462.helpDescription:
Siege Breaker are all-rounder units that are deadly to most armies, and effective against soft targets and armored units alike as well as dangerous to rotary wings and drones. They are hard targets, able to withstand most of firepower that would put an ordinary human into a hospital, so prepare accordingly. It is suggested to attack them from a distance, with aerial units or artillery.

Mutations came from Dr. Sheytani’s lab, making him the only known suspect for this mutation outbreak. His research should lead to something so we should follow through but keep a close eye on him, the supplies we will receive will certainly bolster our chances of survival.
50462.longDescription:
“*Bone Crushers were clearly highly-evolved creatures designed to destroy humanity. You handled them decently, albeit not as clean as I had hoped. Nevertheless, the threat keeps rising. Large mechanical tanks called *Siege Breakers* have crushed a few cities already, and are a threat unlike any you have seen. This global catastrophe happened because, I suspect, the mutagen leaked from my laboratory. Probably by the hand of a bitter or a greedy scientist. We were researching how to revert the zombie plague. My research, and redemption, can now begin. Defeat three of them, and I will reward you for any data you are able to collect.*”

[image, missions-mission_89]
50462.shortDescription: **Destroy** three *Siege Breaker* that can swat rotary wings and drones away, and pose a significant threat to anyone in its path.
50462.title: Survival of the Fittest III

50463.helpDescription:
Mutant Titan is a behemoth able to destroy even the strongest armies head-to-head, take it out from afar, and stop it from reaching your cities or lose them. Hivemind appears if mutations progress too far, making all mutant units much more intelligent and a worse threat to us all. Preventing Hiveminds is necessary for survival, and destroying them should be your highest priority.

Doctor Pasar Sheytani will lead us on no more. Our troops fought bravely, and we will fight back and win against the mutant threat. This has been going on for long enough; the doctor must follow through or face the consequences.
50463.longDescription:
“*Despite great losses, you have accomplished seemingly the improbable. The data you have sent will be very useful indeed. Finally, there is one more step before the research is complete, and my improvement is ready. There is a sinister threat arising, although it might not be revealed yet. Find and destroy, if you can, a large behemoth called the Mutant Titan, its devastation knows no bounds. If you are unable to, instead you could destroy a Hivemind and collect samples for my research, although this task is not much safer either.*”

[image, missions-mission_90]
50463.shortDescription: **Destroy** a *Mutant Titan* OR a *Hivemind* to suppress the worst threat to humanity!
50463.title: Survival of the Fittest IV

50464.helpDescription: Doctor Pasar Sheytani is clearly the one responsible for the mutations, and he slipped from our grasp! Our intelligence cannot track him, as if he disappeared from the face of the Earth. All we can do is prepare to defeat him next time he emerges from the shadows.
50464.longDescription:
“*Thank you for the assistance in my research, but this is sadly where we must part ways. My research was about how easily you can destroy mutants, but the end goal has always been to improve them in their goal to eradicate the flawed mankind, and materialistic wars over land and money. Don’t bother trying to find me, I know how to hide my tracks. Next time you see me, your petty country will be reduced to rubble.*
*Farewell.*”

[image, missions-mission_91]
50464.title: Survival of the //Fittest// Mutants V

50484.longDescription:
With the extreme division happening between political ideologies within all countries, the shattered countries war over the rulership of their former selves, whilst independent extremists rise and take hold of vital areas required for sustained warfare against all other contenders. 

**Take and hold Control Points** held by extremist groups in order to *defeat your adversaries*. Control Points provide Victory Points, as well as Biotech Plants within each nation. There are a few different types of Control Points, some provide less Victory Points but all provide useful resources to turn the tide of war.

**Victory Points work differently**, as conquest is not the way to victory, only a way to destroy and eliminate opposition. *Control Points generate Victory Points* daily, and you do not lose your Victory Points even if you lose possession of the Control Points.

**Pharmaceutical Foundries** are new type of Control Points that *provide Pharmaceuticals* regularly so you can maintain combat-readiness at all times. By taking hold of them, you will ensure you approach victory both by domination of Control Points and by strengthening all your armies.

**Rafael ‘Jaguar’ Teixeira** is an *unparalleled helicopter Officer* who will commandeer the skies to your will. With his strategic brilliance, all Rotary-Wing squadrons in his vicinity will outperform all their previous results, as he coordinates their efforts.

[image, missions-mission_128]
50500.shortDescription: **Research** *Rafael ‘Jaguar’ Teixeira*, an expert of Rotary-Wing warfare.

50501.longDescription:

[image, missions-mission_129]

[image, missions-mission_130]
50502.shortDescription: **Mobilize** *Rafael ‘Jaguar’ Teixeira* to blaze your choppers across the skies, destroying all in its wake.

50503.helpDescription: [step 1, missions-help-mission_131_1, When Legendary Officer is selected, the AoE outline can be seen.][step 2, missions-help-mission_131_2, All your units within this area have increased capabilities.][step 3, missions-help-mission_131_3, If a unit in your control is outside of the Officer’s AoE, the benefits will cease to be applied.]
50503.longDescription:
**Legendary Officers** have the ability to *strengthen nearby applicable units*, increasing their damage output, speed and self-repairing.

[image, missions-mission_131]
50503.shortDescription: **Destroy** *five enemy units* and showcase your prowess at deploying your Legendary Officers into the forge of war.
50503.title: Coordinated Assault

50504.longDescription:

With his strategic brilliance, all Armored and Mechanized Infantry units in his vicinity will outperform all their previous results, as he coordinates their efforts with deadly precision.

[image, missions-mission_132]
50504.shortDescription: **Research** *Aleksei ‘Grom’ Potapov*, an expert of armored vehicular warfare.
50504.title: Crunch of Steel I

50505.helpDescription: Aleksei ‘Grom’ Potapov is an Armored Officer of legendary renown, providing a wide Area-of-Effect (AoE) enhancement in which all armored and Mechanized Infantry units have increased performance. If the enhanced unit leaves the AoE then they will lose the performance benefits.

50505.shortDescription: **Construct** *Arms Industry and Army Base level 3* to be able to equip your Legendary Officer with a Tank of magnificent firepower worthy of his skills.

50506.longDescription:
With **Aleksei ‘Grom’ Potapov** as your Armored Officer, *crush the lands* and have all your Armored and Mechanized Infantry units strengthened by his presence.

[image, missions-mission_134]
50506.shortDescription: **Mobilize** *Aleksei ‘Grom’ Potapov* to blaze with your tanks across the land, crushing any opposing armored steel that stands against you.
50506.title: Crunch of Steel III

50507.helpDescription: Combat Outposts are provincial defensive buildings that decreases attacker’s combat strength, and fortifies the units stationed within the province. Additionally, if the province is conquered by enemies, the building is destroyed. Building Combat Outposts in highly contested areas can provide weaker armies longer period of fighting, allowing you to reinforce them or provide them with aerial or artillery support. It is important to keep in mind that Combat Outposts on their own do not protect provinces.
50507.longDescription:
**Combat Outpost** is a *provincial defensive building* that decreases attacker’s combat strength, and fortifies your units stationed in the province. We need it to build Air Defense Platforms to further protect our land and our people.

[image, missions-mission_136]
50507.shortDescription: **Construct** a *Combat Outpost* to be ready to develop Air Defense Platform for protection of your air-space.
50507.title: We Track, Flak, and Kill I

50508.helpDescription: Air Defense Platforms are versatile defensive buildings that can take out any airborne unit, excelling against planes but not being the best against any. They provide air space protection but will easily be overcome if a strong enough air flotilla destroys enough of them. Constructing enough of them and keeping it upgraded will ensure a safety bubble against most common airborne threats.
50508.longDescription:
**Air Defense Platform** is a *defensive structure* that is capable of taking down all airborne units. Construct two of them to provide protection to your units on the ground.

[image, missions-mission_137]
50508.shortDescription: **Construct** two *Air Defense Platforms* and exert your might over the skies.
50508.title: We Track, Flak, and Kill II

50509.helpDescription: Air Defense Platforms are versatile defensive buildings that can take out any airborne unit, excelling against planes but not being the best against any. They provide air space protection but will easily be overcome if a strong enough air flotilla destroys enough of them. Constructing enough of them and keeping it upgraded will ensure a safety bubble against most common airborne threats.
50509.longDescription:
**Air Defense Platforms** are in place, *neutralize five enemy airborne units* to show your enemies you are untouchable due to your air defense ecosystem.

[image, missions-mission_138]
50509.shortDescription: **Neutralize** any *five airborne units* as a show of your air defense power.
50509.title: We Track, Flak, and Kill III

50510.helpDescription: Mobile Anti-Air Vehicle is a unit that provides stable defense against most airborne enemy units to any army, especially against helicopters. It has a smaller attack radius than a mobile SAM vehicle, but effective against most airborne targets, unlike SAM. It is not optimal for extreme environments or forests and jungles, as it excels in (sub)urban and open-field terrains.
50510.longDescription:
**Mobile Anti-Air Vehicle** is a *good anti-air unit* against any airborne target and an excellent support unit for any army. We need to research it in order to also improve our Air Defense technology.

[image, missions-mission_139]
50510.shortDescription: **Research** the *Mobile Anti-Air Vehicle to level 2* to be able to upgrade your Air Defense Platform further.
50510.title: We Track, Flak, and Kill IV

50511.helpDescription: Air Defense Platforms are versatile defensive buildings that can take out any airborne unit, excelling against planes but not being the best against any. They provide air space protection but will easily be overcome if a strong enough air flotilla destroys enough of them. Constructing enough of them and keeping it upgraded will ensure a safety bubble against most common airborne threats. To upgrade your Air Defense Platform, you must research Mobile Anti-Air Vehicle, as these two units are tied.
50511.longDescription:
**Improving** our technology is crucial to stay a strong world power and contend with others, *upgrade the Air Defense technology* further. Prove to the world the sky is yours.

[image, missions-mission_140]
50511.shortDescription: **Research** the *Air Defense Platform* further to secure your air dominance.
50511.title: We Track, Flak, and Kill V

54916.helpDescription: [step 1, missions-help-mission_141_1, Tectonic break caused the world to change from once recognizable shape. Adapt quickly and prepare to attack and defend in this new environment.][step 2, missions-help-mission_141_2, Refineries are the best way to generate the electronics your nation needs to build, maintain, and mobilize its units. Capture them to gain an edge over rivals who are still struggling to power their forces.][step 3, missions-help-mission_141_3, Stage 1 refineries turn scrap into electronics with no input, but they're the least efficient. Upgrade to stage 2 to feed them supplies, rare materials, fuel, or components for far more electronics. Spread them across different inputs so you never drain one resource, feeding each whatever you need least.]
54916.longDescription:
A solar flare of terrifying proportions struck the Earth, burning through cities and tearing the world's electronic infrastructure. As it warped the planet's magnetic field, the tectonic plates cracked and drifted, oceans flooded the gaps, and the world was left sundered. As the tremors settled, the survivors salvaged what was left of the old world. From the wreckage the scientists built refineries, factories that can turn scrap or raw materials into precious circuitry.

**Tectonic Shatter and Shift** tore the continents apart, causing nations to be split in half and others to separate from their long-established neighbors. Knowing the battlefield is half the battle, prepare to learn fast. 

**Take control of Refineries** as they are the best way to generate electronics for your nation and overcome your adversaries. The more you control, the more of an edge you will have against your enemies on any units that require electronics to produce and maintain.

**Upgrade Refineries** by choosing between different variants of the same refinery. Think carefully about which resource you want to feed in to generate electronics.

[image, missions-mission_141]
54916.shortDescription: **Read more** about the unique *rules of this scenario*.
54916.title: Survive Solar Flare

54917.helpDescription: Refineries are one of the best ways to generate electronics. At level 1 they don't take any resources as input, but they are also the least efficient. Each refinery is heavily guarded by an AI-controlled nation, so it's best to send a decent force to take it over.
54917.longDescription:
With your electronic powerhouse cities crippled by the solar flare and generating a fraction of what they once did, your best move is to **seize a refinery** of your own. These machines *turn scrap or chosen raw materials into electronics*, handing you an edge your opponents would kill for.

[image, missions-mission_142]
54917.title: Electric Monopoly I

54918.helpDescription: Refineries can be upgraded to stage 2 in four different ways: they can be set to take supplies, rare materials, fuel, or components, generating far more electronics than a stage 1 refinery can. Check your stockpile and choose the input you need the least, based on your playstyle. You can always revert to a stage 1 refinery if your priorities change. It's worth noting that if your refinery gets captured, it won't be destroyed by the enemy, they'll keep it at the same upgrade instead.
54918.longDescription:
With a refinery under our control, we need to **advance the refinery** to take in more valuable raw materials. Check your stockpile, see which material you hold the most of, and build a refinery suited to it. *It will convert that material into electronics far more efficiently*.

[image, missions-mission_143]
54918.shortDescription: **Upgrade** the *Refinery* to your chosen conversion preference.
54918.title: Electric Monopoly II

54919.helpDescription: Upgrading more refineries to stage 2 makes better use of them while producing more electronics. Using different input resources for each will make sure you don't drain any single resource while keeping production up. You can always take advantage of the in-game market to sell off excess electronics and buy the input materials you need.
54919.longDescription:
Having multiple refineries not only gives you the edge over enemies who are struggling to build, maintain, and mobilize their electronic-hungry units, it also establishes you as a strong nation in this new world. **Advance at least two refineries to stage 2**, and *choose a different resource to convert* for each so you don't drain your resources too low.  

[image, missions-mission_144]
54919.title: Electric Monopoly III

54920.helpDescription: Stage 3 refineries make sure you get the best out of each refinery while still keeping a healthy supply of electronics to use. By now you should understand the importance of electronics and the refineries that produce them. Keep track of your resources, and demolish and rebuild refineries based on your preferences. As with stage 2, if a stage 3 refinery is captured it won't be destroyed by the enemy but will retain its stage 3 status.
54920.helpTitle: Upgrading Refineries to their final stage
54920.longDescription:
With steady income of Electronics, mobilization is no longer a problem for us. **Upgrade four refineries to stage 3** to assert your dominance, and remember to *split them across different resources* per needs.

[image, missions-mission_145]
54920.title: Electric Monopoly IV

10114.unitDesc: A tremendous engineering feat, the railgun tears through any armored unit. With projectile velocities up to mach 7, it debuts as a new breed of super weapon that changes the face of warfare forever.

10132.unitDesc: Deployed by infantry, the unmanned ground vehicle adds an extra layer of protection and support in the field. Extremely effective in urban and suburban terrain.

10141.unitDesc: Military gear consumed on deployment of portable units such as UGVs. Must be produced in cities.

10142.unitDesc: Launched by various ground units, this explosive drone autonomously patrols and engages hostile targets within the deployed perimeter. Consumes Deployable Gear on launch.

12394.unitDesc: Fixed-wing ground attack aircraft equipped to neutralize ground-based targets. Capable of dealing with both soft targets as well as hard targets.

12403.unitDesc: A next generation frigate designed to provide support to the fleet. Capable of carrying Helicopters.

20267.unitDesc: Mercenaries, a diverse group motivated by financial gain, bring unique combat skills to the battlefield. Their unpredictable nature and loyalty for hire make them a dynamic addition to any strategic operation.

20276.unitDesc: Motorized Infantry that received specialist training and equipment to perform better in cold and winter weather. Those troops move more easily in mountains and tundra, and they fight significantly better there, to the detriment of performances in more regular terrains.

2039.unitDesc:
Motorized Infantry transported by light vehicles. Its primary role is to hold strategic targets, such as towns or cities. 
Doctrine’s benefits: +10% HP

2046.unitDesc: Light infantry supported by transport helicopters for rapid intervention. Especially effective deep behind enemy lines. This unit fights as Helicopter during the first phase of combat.

2053.unitDesc: Naval infantry deploys by land or sea to respond to crises. This lighter variant of mechanized infantry offers faster traverse speed and amphibious capability, bringing the fight to the enemy with a strong offensive focus.

2060.unitDesc:
Mechanized infantry is especially suited for accompanying heavy armor. Mechanized support and flank protection greatly increases any armored unit's survivability.
Doctrine’s benefits: +25% Soft Damage, +10% Speed

2067.unitDesc:
Special forces infantry trained in rugged terrain and counter-insurgency missions. These elite warriors are the first on the ground and will not wait to occupy territory - instead moving on to their next kill.
- Radar Signature Size: NONE

2075.unitDesc:
Combat vehicle combining decent armor and high mobility to detect, reconnoiter and outmaneuver the enemy. Often used to spearhead an attack, providing mobile surveillance services to the main force. +5% speed in hostile province for army it stacked with.
Doctrine’s benefits: +10% Soft Damage

20815.unitDesc: Operating in the shadows and rarely acknowledged by their governments, these covert operatives excel in warfare with minimal resources. Skilled in hit and run tactics, they gather vital intelligence of the enemy.

2089.unitDesc:
Lightly armored vehicles, combining mobility with heavy firepower. These units are specifically designed to engage and destroy enemy armored vehicles. Often operate in urban environments.
Doctrine’s benefits: Acquires Airlift capacity at Lv.2 rather than Lv.4, -10% Research Cost

2103.unitDesc: Vehicle towed artillery unit firing shells in a high trajectory on stationary targets. Very effective in preparing assaults on defended positions.

2110.unitDesc: Tracked or wheeled amphibious warfare vehicle, developed as ship to shore assault and fire support unit. Armored support unit for naval infantry during landing operations.

21132.unitDesc: Watchful eye in the sky, the Satellite operates in low orbit to gather military intelligence in real time. It is extremely hard to spot and can provide any military a decisive edge in reconnaissance and planning.

21141.unitDesc: Drone Warfare is in its infancy. No one knows yet the full extent to which unmanned equipment will impact the battlefield. Yet, innovative militaries are investing into new units fielding experimental and untested designs, hoping to change the face of war like the first airplanes did.

21150.unitDesc: Sourced from commercial drones refitted with military equipment like thermal cameras, recon drones allow for soldiers to quickly get intel on the battlefield

2117.unitDesc:
Key component of any ground force, the main battle tank is well armored, maneuverable and hard hitting. On the battlefield it seldom operates alone, relying on support from mechanized infantry and other fighting vehicles.
Doctrine’s benefits: +10% HP

2124.unitDesc: Mobile armored artillery vehicle, providing heavy indirect long-range fire support to any frontline unit. Due to its strength this artillery is the goto for any armored task force.

2131.unitDesc: Medium-range, surface-to-air missile vehicle. Provides air cover to advancing units. Detects enemies with its radar, and engages aircraft and missiles. Does not engage low flying helicopters.

2138.unitDesc: Long-range, surface-to-air missile system. Provides heavy air cover to large areas and cities. Detects incoming enemies with its radar and engages aircraft and missiles. Does not engage low flying helicopters.

2145.unitDesc: Mobile rocket launcher vehicle, bringing long-range rocket artillery support to the battlefield. Capable of laying down a devastating barrage of destruction this weapon is feared by armor and infantry alike.

2152.unitDesc: Heavy transport helicopter, used to quickly deploy troops and materiell to the front lines. Evades most Anti Air Missile detection by flying NOE.

2153.unitDesc:
Medium armed rotary-wing combat aircraft, focussing on soft or lightly armored targets. Usually equipped with heavy machine guns and missile pods. Evades Anti Air Missile detection by flying NOE.
Doctrine’s benefits: +20% Soft Damage, -15% Mobilization Time

2160.unitDesc: Specialized rotary-wing aircraft, equipped to detect and engage submarines and surface vessels with torpedoes and missiles. Evades Anti Air Missile detection by flying NOE.

2167.unitDesc:

Doctrine’s benefits: +33% Soft Damage, +25% Sight Range

2175.unitDesc:
Fixed-wing combat aircraft with the primary role of establishing total air dominance, ensuring friendly ground units in the theatre of operations remain safe from air attacks.
Doctrine’s benefits: +25% Soft and Hard Damage, +10% HP

2182.unitDesc: Specialized fixed-wing aircraft, equipped to detect and engage submarines and surface vessels with torpedoes and guided missiles.

2189.unitDesc: Airborne early-warning and control aircraft providing long-range, all-weather radar surveillance. Equipped with powerful sensors these planes can often spot distant enemy airplane, helicopter and armored ground unit movement.

2196.unitDesc: Carrier-based fighter airplane with the primary role of establishing total air dominance, ensuring friendly naval units in the theatre of operations remain safe from air attacks. Equipped to land on aircraft carriers.

2203.unitDesc: Carrier-based multi-role fighter with a focus on air-to-ground attack missions. Well equipped to counter air threats, the real value of the strike fighter is it's deep strike capability. Equipped to land on aircraft carriers.

2210.unitDesc: Long-range heavy bomber, used to penetrate deep into enemy airspace and attack strategic ground targets.

2217.unitDesc: Fixed-wing multi-role combat aircraft with a focus on air-to-ground attack missions. Well equipped to counter air threats, the real value of the strike fighter is it's deep strike capability against both armored and soft targets.

2224.unitDesc:

23166.unitDesc: Pharmaceuticals that are used to provide Medical care to units. Must be produced in cities.

2524.unitDesc:
Largest and most dangerous surface vessel in any fleet besides the aircraft carrier. Predominately used as a platform for cruise missiles, artillery and torpedoes.
Doctrine’s benefits: +25% Aircraft Damage, -7.5% Mobilization Cost

2531.unitDesc:
Mid-sized fleet escort vessel, protecting larger ships against both submarine and surface threats. Able to deploy sea mines, a static defense able to forbid passage to enemy ships and submarines
Doctrine’s benefits: +10% Submarine Vessel Damage, +33% Soft and Hard Unit Damage

2538.unitDesc: Agile fleet escort vessel, very effective at creating a solid anti-air envelope around friendly surface units.

2545.unitDesc: Largest combat ship in the fleet. Serving as a seagoing airbase this vessel dramatically increases the nation's global power projection capability. Being a primary target, the carrier needs to be protected against any kind of threat at all times.

Light Flagship of a fleet. Often used as budget options compared to more expensive carriers, those ships increase significantly a nation ability to project power over the sea. As a ship dedicated to support and launching helicopters, it needs additional vessels to protect it.

Cannot stack with Aircraft Carrier.

2628.unitDesc: Mobile, land-based launcher for long range ICBMs, designed for nuclear warhead delivery. The ultimate strategic deterrent, causing devastating damage and contamination.

2665.unitDesc: Warhead containing high explosives generally used against military targets and buildings. Automatically consumed when launching a Cruise Missile or Ballistic Missile.

2666.unitDesc: Warhead containing highly toxic chemicals released over a wide area. Most effective against soft targets (people). Automatically consumed when launching a Cruise Missile or Ballistic Missile. Causes contamination.

2674.unitDesc: Warhead containing a nuclear device, releasing immense amounts of explosive energy and radioactivity. Automatically consumed when launching a Cruise Missile, Ballistic Missile or ICBM. Causes contamination.

5814.unitDesc: MANTAK's next-generation Main Battle Tank is the definition of a moving fortress combined with devastating firepower. It boasts superior armor and is designed to excel in any terrain.

8234.unitDesc: BAE System's next-generation Main Battle Tank ships with unrivaled protection against airbourne threats, and state of the art optic systems. Coupled with incredible survivability, victory comes as standard.

8238.unitDesc: The revived Black Eagle prototype comes with major upgrades to face the challenges of modern warfare. Its synthesis of incredible mobility and firepower make it the ultimate hunter-killer unit.

8242.unitDesc: The Chosen's most fanatic fighters, enforcers will stop at nothing to carry out their divine duty.

8243.unitDesc:
Driven by unquenchable bloodlust, the undead strike fear into the hearts of even the most battle hardened veterans. Deadly in groups, they can become overwhelming if left unchecked, and enter a frenzy around Hives and densely populated areas.
• Undead are deemed as Hard targets as conventional, handheld firarms have proven ineffective against them.
• Invisible from radar

8244.unitDesc: The RAH-Comanche is designed for one thing: Search and destroy. Boasting impressive speed and an ability to wreak havoc, this attack helicopter promises ultimate control of the battlefield.

8247.unitDesc: Sikorsky’s high-speed attack helicopter brings the fight right to the enemy’s doorstep. Boasting incredible power against ground units, this unit can be in and out in a flash, leaving only devastation in its wake.

8250.unitDesc: This modified Ka-52 unit is an extra dose of deadly. True to its name, the Flying Lightning hits fast, hits hard, and destroys everything it comes into contact with.

8444.unitDesc: Designed to excel in littoral combat, the air-independent propulsion powered submarine is the ultimate silent killer. Taking her out to blue water is strongly discouraged.
